thread:
Aaron: Quick thought: introduce a 'commit-token' flow for config changes so owners can apply validated checkpoints instead of ad-hoc flips. Less surprise, easier audits.

Lin: Can you sketch the flow? :thinking_face:

Aaron: Sketch: 1) create change -> 2) run preflight (shadow/dry-run or sampled replay) -> 3) if preflight passes, mint commit-token (immutable id) -> 4) token is promotable to prod; promotion applies diffs and records base-token check.

Sonia: Nice. A few must-haves: token contains gate params + short metric snapshot (not full timeseries), token creator, sim job id, and a short human diff. Also TTL and revocation list.

Aaron: Agreed. Example token string: token:CFG:6299990000:sim-1203:sha256=deadbeef. We store flat metadata in audit log and link to metrics dataset for verification.

Lin: For the Console, show tokens in a compact timeline card. Each card shows status (draft, passed, promoted, revoked), who minted it, and a tiny diff summary. Click expands to metrics preview and a 'promote' button with preflight re-check.

Sonia: Operational rules: on promote, system verifies current base-token matches token.base_ref. If mismatch -> reject promote and produce conflict report. Also require manual override after N auto-pause events.

Aaron: API proto (one-line JSON in message): POST /api/v1/tokens/mint -> {"change":"flag.route_by_cost=on","simulate":"shadow:0.01","gate":"cumulative_metric:24h","promote_on_pass":"false"}

Lin: What about replays and cost control? Limit in-console historical replay to 6h by default and cap per-org daily replay credits. Add "preview-lite" that runs sampled shadowing to estimate deltas quickly.

telemetry-bot: preflight queued: sim-1203 (mode=shadow,sample=0.01) expected ~2m.

Sonia: Failure handling: token stays in 'failed' state with sim logs attached. Teams can iterate and create new tokens. If a promoted token later shows regressions, we mint a 'revert-token' and publish a new token that records the revert. No destructive deletes; everything is append-only.

Aaron: Authn: only token-owner or role 'config-promoter' can promote. For private deployments, require signed tokens via KMS attestation header.

Lin: UX: add a 'verify token' button that runs a lightweight verification (compare stored snapshot vs current metrics). If verification fails mark token 'unverifiable'. Also show TTL: stale after 30d and auto-archive after 90d.

Sonia: Telemetry hooks: emit events token.minted, token.verified, token.promoted, token.revoked with token id and short summary. Those feed the audit timeline + BI exports.

ops-bot: sim-1203 completed -> gates: pass(error_rate<=0.25%,p95<=2.5%) -> token minted token:CFG:6299990000:sim-1203:sha256=deadbeef.

Aaron: Next steps: 1) short RFC with token format + lifecycle, 2) telemetry contract for the token snapshot payload, 3) Console mock for token timeline and promote flow, 4) CLI helpers rictl token mint/promote/verify. Who wants the RFC?

Sonia: I'll take the RFC and include sample audit entries and KMS attestation flow.

Lin: I'll mock Console tiles and the promote modal. Also prototype a 'preview-lite' that returns CI.

Aaron: Thanks. I'll stub the API routes and add a checklist to the rollout RFC.

telemetry-bot: note: added checklist item "define token snapshot schema (flat string fields)" to RFC-729.
